vBRIEFInfo.description: Binary codec: frame encode/decode, fragmentation, OMUX magic

narratives.Description: Implement the xumux binary frame format in src/codec/. Covers standard (6-byte) and extended (8-byte) frame encoding and decoding, a streaming partial-read decoder suitable for TCP/stdio byte streams, message fragmentation (split large messages into FRAGMENT/FRAGMENT_END frames), fragment reassembly (accumulate until FRAGMENT_END, error on interleaving), and OMUX magic number write/validate for stream-oriented transports. All code in this scope is browser-safe (zero Node.js APIs).
narratives.Traces: FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4, FR-5, FR-12, NFR-1
